rows.label: COARSENESS

rows.label: LOW COMEDY
rows.clue: A comedy characterized by slapstick and burlesque

rows.label: PEN NAME

rows.label: PAEAN

rows.label: PLEADING

rows.label: ABLATIVE

rows.label: DENIAL

rows.label: NEWSLETTER
rows.clue: Report or open letter giving informal or confidential news of interest to a special group

rows.label: MORPHEME

rows.label: CURTAIN CALL

rows.label: CLAMORING

rows.label: CENTER SPREAD

rows.label: GOOD MORNING

rows.label: EYE CONTACT
